Inside Macintosh: Telephony /
Chapter 5 - Telephone Manager Messages / Telephone Manager Message Reference
Constants

Call Rejection States

The value parameter of the telCARejectMsg message (page 5-21) contains one of the following constants. 
enum {
   telCallRejectFailed     = 0,
   telCallRejectEst        = 1,
   telCallRejected         = 2
};
Constant descriptions
telCallRejectFailed
Could not reject an incoming call.
telCallRejectEst
An incoming call was rejected.
telCallRejected
An outgoing call was rejected by the destination number.
